title: Higher-Order Marginal Likelihood Approximation for Nonlinear State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian comparison of nonlinear state space models requires integrating over a growing latent state path and a low-dimensional parameter vector. We propose a marginal likelihood approximation that integrates out the states with a numerical or simulation-based evaluator and applies a second-order corrected Laplace approximation to the integral over the static parameters. The correction is expressed through smoothing cumulants of the complete-data log density and, under derivative-growth and posterior-concentration conditions, reduces the log marginal likelihood error from $O(T^{-1})$ to $O(T^{-2})$. In stochastic volatility experiments, it removes 64\% to 99\% of the Laplace error at far lower cost than simulation-based estimators. translated_title: 面向非线性状态空间模型的高阶边际似然近似
translated_abstract: 非线性状态空间模型的贝叶斯模型比较需要对不断增长的潜在状态路径以及一个低维参数向量进行积分。我们提出了一种边际似然近似方法：使用数值方法或基于模拟的求值器将状态积分消去，并对静态参数上的积分应用二阶修正的拉普拉斯近似。该修正通过完全数据对数密度的平滑累积量来表示，并且在导数增长与后验集中条件下，可将边际似然对数误差从 $O(T^{-1})$ 降低至 $O(T^{-2})$。在随机波动率实验中，该方法以远低于基于模拟的估计器的计算成本，消除了 64% 至 99% 的拉普拉斯误差。在二元汇率波动率模型以及包含 $T = 19{,}266$ 个五分钟股票收益样本的应用中，结果对厚尾观测和暂时性波动因子给出了最强的支持。
tldr: 提出了一种针对非线性状态空间模型的高阶边际似然近似方法，通过二阶修正拉普拉斯近似将对数边际似然误差从 $O(T^{-1})$ 降至 $O(T^{-2})$，在随机波动率实验中以远低于模拟方法的成本消除 64%–99% 的拉普拉斯误差，并在汇率波动率与高频股票收益应用中支持厚尾观测与暂时性波动因子的存在。
en_tdlr: Proposes a higher-order marginal likelihood approximation for nonlinear state space models that applies a second-order corrected Laplace approximation to reduce log marginal likelihood error from $O(T^{-1})$ to $O(T^{-2})$, removing 64%–99% of the Laplace error at far lower cost than simulation-based estimators.
